metaData.originalTitle: How Anthropic's cybersecurity team built a threat detection platform with Claude Code | Claude
metaData.title: How Anthropic's cybersecurity team built a threat detection platform with Claude Code | Claude
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic's cybersecurity team built CLUE, a threat detection platform using Claude Code, that automates alert triage, natural language log querying, and investigation, achieving significant time savings and reduced false positives.
metaData.summary: This article details how Jackie Bow's Detection Platform Engineering team at Anthropic built CLUE (Claude Looks Up Evidence), a detection and response platform that leverages Claude Code and tool use to automate and enhance cybersecurity operations. The platform addresses the common problem of security analysts being overwhelmed by data and alerts, requiring context-switching between multiple tools. CLUE consists of two main components: CLUE Triage, which performs first-pass alert enrichment and dispositioning, and CLUE Investigate, which allows analysts to query security logs using natural language. The platform connects to Anthropic's internal systems (Slack, docs, code repos, data warehouses) to provide crucial context for alerts. Key results include a reduction in false positives from ~33% to 7%, automated processing of 12,000 queries and 27,000 tool calls in 30 days, and an estimated 5-10x time savings. The team is exploring future directions like proactive threat hunting, using investigation transcripts as a knowledge base, and embracing non-deterministic investigation paths.

mainPoints.point: CLUE automates alert triage and investigation using Claude, reducing false positives and analyst workload.
mainPoints.explanation: CLUE Triage enriches alerts with internal context (Slack, docs, code) and assigns dispositions, dropping false positive rates from ~33% to 7%. CLUE Investigate allows natural language queries of security logs, automating complex investigations that previously took hours.

mainPoints.point: Claude Code enabled rapid development of the CLUE platform, collapsing traditional timelines from weeks to days.
mainPoints.explanation: The team had a proof of concept running in a day and a full implementation within a week. Claude Code acted as both a design partner and collaborator, allowing the team to build features they previously lacked the technical capacity for.

mainPoints.point: The key differentiator is CLUE's access to internal context via tool use, not just external logs.
mainPoints.explanation: By connecting to Slack, internal documentation, code repositories, and data warehouses, Claude can contextualize alerts with institutional knowledge, distinguishing real threats from benign activity like planned maintenance.

mainPoints.point: The team is embracing non-deterministic investigation paths, inspired by the 'bitter lesson' of AI.
mainPoints.explanation: Instead of rigid, pre-defined playbooks, CLUE gives Claude boundaries (tools and data access) but allows it to explore its own investigation strategies, often finding context that human-designed processes would miss.

keyQuotes: I can finally build the tools I always wished I had.
That was when I realized I'm not bound by my own technical limitations anymore. I can build whatever I can think of.
Claude is much better at writing precise queries than humans are.
The next generation of tools should give models the capability to investigate and let them find better approaches than we would have prescribed.
That internal context is the missing piece that really helps alerts be contextualized for your environment.
